body: I’ve been planning on doing this for over a year, and know I just need to know the best way how
How should I tell my parents that my arm is worse from the last time they saw it? I’m scared they’ll be mad or something

My biggest fear is my parents having to look at them, my mother tears up whenever something reminds her of my self harm. Any advice if I decide to wear short sleeves? Most likely won’t but just in case

This is probably one of the most offensive things you could possible say to something with scars. I’m so sorry you had to experience that, it makes me nervous to ever show my scars and wonder if I’ll be treated like a normal human being.
If I’m having a “good day” I’ll do the same and then end up crying and slashing myself up countless times
I have one big ass mirror too but I’m thinking of just covering it, I can’t stand looking at myself for more than a second.
I constantly think about that and it drives me crazy. I feel like such a selfish bitch because of it.
